top_signals.title: US Issues New Round of Iran-Related Shipping Sanctions
top_signals.summary: The United States on Wednesday issued another round of Iran-related sanctions, taking aim at Iran's efforts to "monetize the Strait of Hormuz" with designations of 10 entities and eight more tankers, the U.S. Treasury Department said.Six of the entities targeted for sanctions were based in China…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
